description: r.parent has a child region r.leaf, each with a sleeping task. The driver closes r.parent at 100: the cancel reaches r.leaf first, whose task ends, so r.leaf is Closed (its own Quiescent) before r.parent may complete (every subregion Closed, Quiescent(r) second conjunct): region.closed for r.leaf precedes region.closed for r.parent, both regions end Closed and the run is quiescent.
